Enabled.Name: Enable Manual Dice
Enabled.Hint: Allow permitted users to roll physical dice and type the results into Foundry. While this is off, the Token controls toggle is hidden for everyone.

Roles.Name: Permitted Roles
Roles.Label: Configure Roles
Roles.Hint: Choose which user roles may enter dice results manually. This sets Foundry's "Make Manual Rolls" permission.

RoleConfig.Title: Manual Dice: Permitted Roles
RoleConfig.Hint: Users with a selected role may switch manual dice entry on for themselves from the Token controls. This is Foundry's "Make Manual Rolls" permission, so changing it here also changes it in Configure Permissions.
